title: SBPR.QaHarness.T022 receipt (ADR-0009 §6) — M1
description: The DESCRIPTIVE primitive-fact receipt the helper emits per request. It NEVER contains a product PASS/FAIL verdict — only the external runner composes a verdict (ADR-0009 §6). In M1 the helper still exposes no channel/executor, so no receipt is produced at runtime yet; this schema pins the shape the arming/admission decision would stamp. The 'reason' enum mirrors RejectReason (Core/RejectReason.cs); 'None' denotes an admitted request.

outcome.description: admitted = passed the admission gate; rejected = fail-closed; replayed = cached decision returned for a duplicate (requestId, seq).

reason.description: The RejectReason that fired (None when admitted). Mirrors Core/RejectReason.cs.

observed.description: Descriptive facts only (e.g. tooltip text, field-present bool, quality int). Never a product verdict.
